shortDescription: Creates or removes inventory items from Nautobot

options.name: api_version
options.description: API Version Nautobot REST API

options.name: asset_tag
options.description: The asset tag of the inventory item

options.name: custom_fields
options.description: Must exist in Nautobot and in key/value format

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the inventory item

options.name: device
options.description: Name of the device the inventory item belongs to Required if I(state=present) and the inventory item does not exist yet

options.name: discovered
options.description: Set the discovery flag for the inventory item

options.name: id
options.description: The UUID of the object to operate on

options.name: label
options.description: The label of the inventory item

options.name: manufacturer
options.description: The manufacturer of the inventory item

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the inventory item to be created Required if I(state=present) and the inventory item does not exist yet

options.name: parent_inventory_item
options.description: The parent item of the inventory item

options.name: part_id
options.description: The part ID of the inventory item

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: serial
options.description: The serial number of the inventory item

options.name: software_image_files
options.description: Override the software image files associated with the software version for this inventory item

options.name: software_version
options.description: The software version of the inventory item

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: tags
options.description: Any tags that this item may need to be associated with

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.
